title: Nixon's 1960 assassination team killed JFK

tellings.quote: that in fact the assassination team that was created back in 1960 by Richard Nixon are the ones that killed the president

plain: Dan Sheehan, the guest, says that an assassination team that Richard Nixon set up in 1960 was the same team that killed President John F. Kennedy in Dallas in 1963. Sheehan passes this on from others, naming Santo Trafficante Jr., Andy Toney and William Johnstone Taylor among the people behind it. If true, a plan made inside the government would have been turned on a sitting president.
